title: Document image quality and resubmission
guidance: Unreadable or materially blurred documents require a clearer replacement. No identity or claim decision may be inferred from an unreadable image.

title: Thai identity number integrity
guidance: Thai identity numbers must contain 13 digits and pass the deterministic checksum before automated onboarding can continue.

title: Identity document validity period
guidance: Expired identity documents and unparseable validity dates cannot be accepted for automated onboarding.

title: Medical claim arithmetic integrity
guidance: A mismatch between itemized charges and the stated total requires human review before claim processing.

title: Potentially excluded treatment review
guidance: Potential cosmetic or excluded treatments must be reviewed against the applicable customer policy; keyword detection alone cannot deny a claim.

title: Low-confidence extraction escalation
guidance: Materially uncertain extracted fields must be escalated rather than silently accepted or guessed.

title: Automated validation pass
guidance: A document may proceed automatically only after required deterministic checks pass without risk flags.
